context: Mei reorganizes the family closet with seasonal swap; Sho-young watches.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Curious, light wonder in the opening. Soft voice, genuinely interested—not demanding. The warmth of a child who wants to be let in on what grown-ups do. Slight lean forward in the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 服、季節で整理してるの。
lines.en: I'm sorting the clothes by season.
lines.style: Gentle explanation, welcoming his attention. Warm, unhurried pace. The tone of someone doing a quiet task and not minding company. Slight lift at the end—inviting him closer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: So you're putting away the summer clothes?
lines.style: Soft, checking his understanding—not quite a question, almost thinking aloud. The careful logic of a child working through how things fit together. Open, unrushed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Affirming, matter-of-fact warmth. The practical rhythm of a task explained simply. No rush, no condescension. The tone of someone who enjoys this small work.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I want to help with the folding!
lines.style: Bright, eager surge in the voice. Sudden lift—he's seized by the desire to join in. Genuine enthusiasm, no performance. The emphasis lands on being useful, being included.
